Special Interest Group

Evening Needlepointers

3rd Thursday · 7 – 9 pm Hybrid

An evening group for members who’d rather stitch after the workday — specialty threads, decorative stitches, counted needlepoint, and the finishing techniques that turn a canvas into a finished piece. Every experience level welcome, and you’re always free to bring your own canvas project instead.
